scripts.build: bun run wasm:build && bun --cwd apps/web build
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && bun run build
scripts.dev: bun run wasm:build && bun --cwd apps/web dev
scripts.tauri:build: bun run wasm:build && bun --cwd apps/desktop tauri build --no-bundle
scripts.tauri:dev: bun run wasm:build && bun --cwd apps/desktop tauri dev
